prompt: I have a LaTeX draft of our robotics paper at `project/paper/draft_paper.tex` that I submitted for review. Two reviewers flagged it as looking AI-generated and asked us to fix it before resubmission. I need you to produce a cleaned-up version of the paper saved as `cleaned_paper.tex`. The paper needs to read like it was written by a careful human researcher — a senior PhD student or professor — not an AI assistant. The reviewers specifically mentioned issues with citations, punctuation style, emphasis usage, math notation, and reference density in non-survey sections. Please go through the entire file carefully and fix every instance of these problems.
